notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.15 online today!
notes.notes:
A new update is now available! Have fun with the Race Director Mode and the Weekly Challenges!
[list]
[*] Multiplayer Online: added Race Director Mode
[*] Added Weekly Challenges
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.13 is now available!
notes.notes:
Riders, a new update is now available! Please check all the news in the list below:

[list]
[*] Increased top speed for all motorcycles
[*] Time Trial: rewards are now based on completed laps instead of completed valid laps only
[*] Time Trial: the quick leaderboard in pre-race menu now shows the best valid lap for each bike model 
[*] Reduced grip on grass and sand when “Off-Track Help” option is Off
[*] Missing exhaust on Ducati 1098R RM 2008 added 
[*] Headlights issue on Kawasaki ZX-10R 2004 fixed 
[*] Sparks issue on Kawasaki ZX-6R 2019 fixed
[*] Added support for add-ons
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.8 is now online
notes.notes:

[list]
[*] Improved tyres temperature system 
[*] Improved Anti-Wheelie
[*] Some career thresholds have been revised
[*] Added support for add-ons (PS4-XONE)
[*] Minor fixes
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.7
notes.notes:
Hello Riders! A new update is finally here!
We're always monitoring what the community ask and report to us, and the results are specific patch aimed to improve your gameplay experience. See full detail below:

[list]
[*] Rims on RM and EM models can now be customized with colors and materials
[*] Improved TCS functioning
[*] Missing lights in night career events fixed
[*] Added support for add-ons
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

https://ridevideogame.com/game-updates/new-patch-realesed-ps4-xone-steam-2/

notes.title: NEW GAME UPDATE
notes.notes: We're reading all your comments and are currently working on improving and fixing some aspects of the game. As a first step we're releasing a patch to make the game more tolerant out of track detection. Stay tuned for more updates.
